purpose: Define bounded emergency operational change path with explicit incident/reason, reduced but never absent required gates, retrospective review and audit.

topics.name: Emergency Change Boundary
topics.purpose: Define bounded emergency operational change path with explicit incident/reason, reduced but never absent required gates, retrospective review and audit.

semantics.scope_rule: Target and intended action are exact.
semantics.gate_rule: Only explicitly waivable process gates may be shortened; AccessCore/destructive/security integrity gates remain enforced.
semantics.review_rule: Retrospective review/post-change validation is required by profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Emergency status never grants universal administrator authority.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: critical incident means run arbitrary shell

references.purpose: Emergency changes may derive from exact incident context.
